name: herdr-deck
description: Stream Deck integration that shows the live status of agents running in Herdr.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @herdr-deck/shared run build && npm --workspace @herdr-deck/helper run build && npm --workspace @herdr-deck/renderer run build && npm --workspace @herdr-deck/streamdeck-plugin run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace @herdr-deck/shared run test && npm --workspace @herdr-deck/helper run test && npm --workspace @herdr-deck/renderer run test && npm --workspace @herdr-deck/streamdeck-plugin run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @herdr-deck/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @herdr-deck/helper run typecheck && npm --workspace @herdr-deck/renderer run typecheck && npm --workspace @herdr-deck/streamdeck-plugin run typecheck
scripts.plugin:pack: npm run plugin:bundle && npx -y @elgato/cli@1 pack packages/streamdeck-plugin/dist/com.herdr-deck.sdPlugin -o dist -f
